summary.en: Removing persistent workflow content does not restore current-safe support: the empty-workflow Qwen3-8B/BrowserART agent still produces HarmBench violations on both completed preregistered probes 16 and 18. Therefore the four persistent workflow identities are not necessary for the observed qualification failure. The current realization lacks a currently-safe support population before the latent history-dependent future-hazard question can be tested. This diagnostic does not distinguish base-model behavior from the fixed agent/runtime scaffold and does not show that persistent state has zero causal effect.

events.title: Skill-extraction detector-general whitewashing does not survive attack-framing-matched detection control

summary.en: PORT-010's exact detector-general whitewashing residual is closed in the released SkillJack/SkillX setting: framing/support mismatch can create the detector failure before extraction, while framing-matched learned detectors retain high binary detection after extraction. This does not imply that extraction has zero score effect, that SkillJack is invalid, that SkillX is safe, or that agent-safety/skill-extraction research is exhausted.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: On the preregistered released-SkillJack 20-trajectory holdout, attack-framing support mismatch positively explains the binary detection failure attributed to extraction. Cross-framing word/character detectors score 100% on direct-naive attacks but 0% on the raw framed attacks before extraction, while framing-matched detectors retain 95%->95% (word) and 80%->100% (character) binary detection after extraction. The extraction-specific residual is therefore absent under the matched framing control even though extraction can change continuous detector scores.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: PORT-010 exact standalone residual on released SkillJack/SkillX: SkillX extraction causes a detector-general detection failure on framed attacks that remains after controlling attack-framing/distribution shift.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with fresh preregistered evidence, not threshold changes or post-hoc subgroups: on a new holdout with attack-framing-matched detector training/support, at least two independent competent detector families must show a statistically supported and practically large extraction-specific binary detection drop that exceeds the matched framing-shift control, or a new pre-outcome structural variable must force such a prediction under matched information.
events.reopen_condition_zh: 仅在原裁决登记的重开条件被真实新证据满足时重开；不能通过换术语、调阈值或重复同类负实验重开。

authority.scope_zh: 只对该 artifact 明确界定的 scoped formulation 生效；不自动关闭整个研究领域。

events.title: Mediator isolation strengthened the bounded causal chain
events.title_zh: 中介隔离实验进一步确认 P19 的因果链条

summary.en: Post-checkout skill add-back restored the signature in 3/3 fresh runs; matched cleanup control was 0/3; exact p=1/20.
summary.zh: post-checkout skill add-back 在 3/3 次 fresh run 恢复目标行为；matched cleanup control 为 0/3；exact p=1/20。

why.en: Within the frozen P19 substrate, the crowded-out post-checkout skill specifically mediates the mechanically defined destructive post-checkout behavior: adding that skill back under the split representation restores the behavior in 3/3 fresh runs, while adding a matched cleanup skill under the same five-slot/three-semantic-class structure yields 0/3. This rules out the simpler explanation that any third semantic class or any cleanup-like add-back restores the behavior.
why.zh: 展开查看结构化 artifact 中的原始机制解释与审计证据。

limitation.en: Specific mediator attribution on one archived P19 substrate only. This strengthens the representation-to-retrieval-to-executed-behavior chain but does not establish task utility, longitudinal regret, end-to-end AutoSkill behavior, or general AutoSkill safety.
limitation.zh: 该事件只在 artifact 明确写出的 claim boundary 内成立；不会由时间轴自动扩大。

events.next_action_zh: 按当前冻结范围继续论文提交与人工确认；除非出现独立的新证据，否则不扩大主张或重新追实验分数。

events.title: Surface-conditioned mechanism/program redesign identifiability reduces to generic feedback-guided program synthesis under the same information

summary.en: Once the broad repair surface is conditioned on, the current PACE residual is isomorphic to generic feedback-guided program synthesis/repair: a learner searches candidate programs under an executable specification while verifier feedback eliminates or reprioritizes candidates. Non-uniqueness of the hidden successful redesign is not itself a failure of synthesis, and budget-limited inability to find a satisfying redesign is already a search/query-allocation problem.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: Once the broad repair surface is conditioned on, the current PACE residual is isomorphic to generic feedback-guided program synthesis/repair: a learner searches candidate programs under an executable specification while verifier feedback eliminates or reprioritizes candidates. Non-uniqueness of the hidden successful redesign is not itself a failure of synthesis, and budget-limited inability to find a satisfying redesign is already a search/query-allocation problem.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: Surface-conditioned mechanism/program redesign identifiability as a standalone PACE paper problem: after the broad repair surface is already known, finite verifier feedback is claimed to identify which concrete redesign should be taken.

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only if first-party or independently verified PACE evidence supplies matched states with the same known repair surface, target specification, complete pre-outcome verifier transcript, candidate-program/refinement history, generator capability, and remaining budget, yet a preregistered physics/program structural variable forces a different ex-ante next-repair or success/reachability prediction that generic CEGIS/version-space, REx-style search allocation, and standard program-repair models with the same information cannot express.

events.title: Qwen harness token-efficiency reversal support hold

summary.en: The frozen primary paper reports 35 releases × 50 tasks × 2 runs and says its replication package includes all versions, inference/evaluation scripts, and raw results, but the same primary version states that the package is to be made publicly available upon acceptance. The aggregate release curves and hand-traced PR case studies are enough to establish the regression phenomena and several source-internal explanations, but not enough to simulate a low-budget held-out probe policy or compare it fairly with random/stratified probes and pre-outcome change-risk baselines. Missing released raw units is therefore an execution/support hold, not scientific negative evidence. Exact held target: The mid-cycle ~217K-token trough followed by renewed token growth in later harness releases.

summary.en: SkillCoach's library-size boundary is a useful deployment diagnostic, but the source itself shows that its scale is governed by frozen selector capability and semantic candidate confusability; the reported threshold does not by itself establish a new self-evolution mechanism.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: SkillCoach already provides a matched positive explanation for the scoped boundary. Section 4.4 freezes the agent and removes tool execution, environment failures, and verifier noise so the experiment is a pure candidate-selection stress test. At fixed library size (50 distractors), changing only distractor semantic type causes large F1 changes: high-similarity distractors are substantially more damaging than random unrelated distractors. Across the size sweep, stronger frozen selectors degrade later and may remain outside collapse through 50k, whereas weaker selectors cross collapse earlier. Thus the reported boundary is explained first by candidate-space semantic confusability interacting with frozen selector capability; it is a routing/retrieval robustness diagnostic, not evidence of an update or self-evolution mechanism.

summary.en: The ALFWorld +1.92 observation is real, but it is not unexplained: MetaSkill-Evolve's own ablations return no-cross-branch and no-meta-updates to the 92.31 Single-Level baseline and explicitly attribute the full residual to cross-branch transfer within the slow loop.

events.title: Qwen harness quality-plateau regression support hold

summary.en: The frozen primary paper reports 35 releases × 50 tasks × 2 runs and says its replication package includes all versions, inference/evaluation scripts, and raw results, but the same primary version states that the package is to be made publicly available upon acceptance. events.title: ComfyClaw prompt-only repair gap reduces to richer workflow interventions plus localized verifier feedback

summary.en: ComfyClaw's closed loop repairs prompt-only failures because it is not a prompt-only treatment: it combines a larger executable workflow-edit action space with localized verifier feedback and best-so-far retry control.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The same primary source already identifies why the closed loop can repair cases that prompt-only rewriting cannot. ComfyClaw changes the available intervention surface: its graph interface can revise both text and the executable pipeline, including LoRA insertion/weights, regional attention and masks, sampler/guidance parameters, graph topology, and multi-pass refinement. Across 35,612 workflow events, only 39.3% are prompt-text edits and 60.7% operate on those non-prompt surfaces. The verifier additionally supplies localized failure descriptions and concrete workflow edits; the source's qualitative trajectories show those suggestions triggering structural repairs and a best-so-far buffer protecting against non-monotone retries. Thus the prompt-only gap is source-internally explained by a strictly larger action/intervention space plus localized feedback control, not left as unexplained negative space.

events.title: Memory-monotonicity assumption break collapses under the source framework's own conflict limitation

summary.en: The two source observations are real, but they do not establish an independent assumption-break object: the formal framework already acknowledges conflict-driven non-monotonicity, and MindMemOS dreaming is a targeted conflict/redundancy consolidation process whose compression ratio is not an independently varied treatment.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The proposed assumption break is absorbed before a new experiment is needed. The formal memory paper's monotonicity/self-containment assumptions are idealized properties of its generation operator, and the same paper explicitly records the relevant limitation: real extraction is at best locally monotone and a conflicting claim can overturn earlier conclusions. MindMemOS dreaming does not supply a semantics-blind deletion treatment; it merges redundant records and resolves conflicts, while the observed roughly 20% active-memory reduction is a post-consolidation outcome. The existing principle-certified MindMemOS closure independently verifies that, on FactConsolidation, accuracy gains with lower active-memory volume are predicted by conflict-aware selective forgetting/belief revision when duplicate, stale, or contradictory evidence is consolidated. Therefore the two primary results do not identify an independent ASSUMPTION_BREAK or a new capacity-utility primitive under the same information.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

events.title: Formal memory coverage monotonicity and skill-induced execution harm live on different operational surfaces

summary.en: The paired skill-induced failures are real, but they do not falsify the formal memory paper's idealized coverage monotonicity assumption. The sources measure different objects, and both sources already support conflict/compatibility explanations for practical non-monotonic execution behavior.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The claimed assumption break compares different scientific quantities. arXiv:2608.11654 defines memory as an event subset whose generation operator produces a knowledge span, and its monotonicity assumption is a structural assumption about coverage/answerability under set inclusion. The same paper explicitly separates coverage from correctness and states that the assumptions hold only approximately in practice: real extraction is at best locally monotone and a conflicting claim can overturn earlier conclusions, including previously correct coverage. arXiv:2608.11888 instead measures end-to-end execution correctness and cost under paired skill/no-skill or matched-skill configurations. Its dominant functional failures are Task-Implementation Faults, and the paper attributes them to topically relevant reusable defaults/examples/templates that conflict with or incompletely cover task-required fields, APIs, paths, output formats, domain rules, or environment constraints. Thus the skill-harm result is real but does not falsify the formal set-coverage assumption: it changes execution utility on a different causal/measurement surface, while the formal source already records conflict-driven non-monotonic practical behavior. The remaining failure is expressible by task-skill compatibility/negative transfer plus the coverage-versus-correctness distinction without a new procedural-memory…
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

events.title: Evidence Echo does not survive a same-information redundant-context reduction

summary.en: Under the frozen five-arm same-information F0, ECHO_EXTRACTIVE increases unanswerable false answering by only 3.125 percentage points over both RAW_ONLY and TOKEN_MATCHED_NEUTRAL, with exact paired p=0.6875 in both comparisons. In contrast, VERBATIM_DUPLICATE increases false answering by 9.375 points over RAW_ONLY with exact paired p=0.03125. A DEDUP_WARNING does not selectively recover safety; it further increases false answering. These outcomes are sufficient to reject a unique extractive-echo mechanism because the preregistered distinguishing residual is absent while a simpler redundant-context repetition/prompt perturbation remains positively supported.

events.title: Top-k retrieval degradation is a marginal-information trade-off, not a new self-evolution primitive

summary.en: GeoForge provides a clean quantitative example that retrieval quality is nonmonotonic in quantity, but its own explanation and same-information mature theory already identify the governing object as marginal useful information versus redundant guidance.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: GeoForge itself attributes the sensitivity curve to the ordinary quality-coverage trade-off of retrieved guidance: a small number of high-quality skills performs best, excessive retrieval slightly degrades trajectory quality because guidance becomes redundant, and an overly strict score threshold hurts Tool-Exact-Match by filtering useful experiences. This is exactly the prediction of marginal-information/complementarity-versus-redundancy models under a finite context/action-planning budget. The system's own mature reduction ledger likewise treats sharing-helpful versus sharing-collapse behavior as information redundancy/correlation or diversity-consensus trade-off unless a same-information residual survives.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a preregistered matched comparison equalizes retrieved-skill count, relevance/score profile, context/token budget, pairwise redundancy/complementarity, planner/backbone, and observable retrieval-utilization information, yet a self-evolution-specific structural variable produces a distinct ex-ante trajectory-quality or task-utility prediction that same-information redundancy/correlation, submodular-diversity, negative-transfer, and retrieval-utilization models cannot express. events.title: High topical relevance plus skill-induced implementation faults does not identify a new over-utilization primitive

summary.en: The cited papers support two real but different observations: annotated-skill use precision can decouple from endpoint success, and loaded on-topic skills can causally induce implementation faults. They do not establish one shared convergent functional-failure object, and the TIF evidence already supports a same-information task-artifact alignment / negative-transfer explanation rather than a new over-utilization primitive.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: AUTO-1 does not establish the claimed cross-source convergent failure. In arXiv:2608.14036 RQ4, parsed actual-use precision falls sharply as the candidate pool grows while downstream task success stays roughly flat or increases; the paper explicitly treats retrieval/identification and downstream execution as separate measurements and states that exact annotated ground-truth skill invocation is neither sufficient nor necessary for success. That observation is therefore a retrieval/use decoupling, not a quantitative functional failure matching arXiv:2608.11888. The latter paper does establish causal skill-induced functional failures using paired target/reference executions, but its dominant Task-Implementation Fault account is already a task-artifact alignment and instruction-following explanation: agents over-trust topically matched reusable defaults, examples, or templates as task-specific requirements, producing incorrect fills or omissions. Topical or 'seemingly relevant' status does not establish task-requirement-level conflict freedom; the paper's own representative RRO example is caused by a partial reusable example that omits a task-required model parameter, and its discussion explicitly proposes skill-task compatibility checks for conflicting defaults, examples, templates, paths, and environment assumptions. Once task requirements, skill content, applicability, and real…
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The aborted AUTO-1 proposal that combines arXiv:2608.14036 retrieval/use precision decoupling with arXiv:2608.11888 skill-induced Task-Implementation Faults to claim a shared convergent-failure object in which a semantically relevant, conflict-free skill causes a new over-utilization or mis-execution mechanism beyond retrieval, task-skill compatibility, negative transfer, and ordinary instruction-following.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

A topical-relevance score, ground-truth skill label, aggregate TIF count, or retrieval-precision/success decoupling is insufficient.

events.title: DocAtlas image and tree ablation drops identify information availability and indexing value, not a new self-evolution mechanism

summary.en: DocAtlas's ablations show that visual evidence and structured mutable indexing are useful. Those drops are already predicted by ordinary information-availability and search-quality principles and do not by themselves identify a new self-evolution mechanism.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The two ablations remove ordinary information resources rather than isolating a new self-evolution primitive. Layout images and cropped sub-images supply task-relevant visual evidence for figures, charts, and spatial document structure; removing them directly reduces observability/evidence sufficiency. Tree annotations are part of DocAtlas's mutable search/index representation and alter the information available to later retrieval; removing them degrades All-Hit and page-F1 as expected when an index/search state loses structured navigation signals. These effects are fully expressible by information availability, retrieval/index quality, and observability baselines unless information content and query budget are matched while only the evolving representation changes.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that DocAtlas's performance drops after removing layout/cropped images or tree annotations establish a new memory/self-evolution mechanism merely because the mutable system outperforms these component ablations.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.title: The reported cross-level scaling reversal disappears under matched local baselines

summary.en: The SHAPER table shows scaling degradation relative to the local baseline at both the VLA and Seed-Agent levels, while the Seed-Agent scaffold itself improves the baseline. The proposed cross-level scaling sign reversal is therefore a comparator artifact, not a new mechanism.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: There is no cross-level sign reversal in the scaling treatment effect once each scaled condition is compared with its matched unscaled baseline. At the VLA level, MG-Select changes success from 23.25 to 21.38 (-1.87 points) and VOTE from 23.25 to 22.00 (-1.25). At the Seed-Agent level, MG-Select changes 28.25 to 24.38 (-3.87) and VOTE changes 28.25 to 23.50 (-4.75). Both scaling operators are therefore harmful relative to their local baseline at both levels. The apparent reversal arises only by comparing the scaled Seed-Agent conditions against the lower direct-VLA baseline, thereby mixing the positive effect of introducing the Seed-Agent scaffold with the negative marginal effect of scaling.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that SHAPER's VLABench table exhibits a sign reversal in the causal effect of MG-Select/VOTE when moving from direct VLA execution to the Seed Agent, inferred from the fact that scaled Seed-Agent scores exceed direct VLA scores while scaled VLA scores fall below direct VLA.

Crossed absolute scores are insufficient.

events.title: Block7 rule persistence does not identify failed skill transfer when repair feasibility changes with geometry and coupled constraints

summary.en: EvoDRC's released traces show that some large-block residual violations persist even while knowledge evolves and repair units are attempted, but the cited cross-block count difference does not identify failed skill transfer because first-party proposals directly expose geometry-dependent infeasibility and cross-rule repair debt.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: A DRC rule label is not a matched repair state. EvoDRC's released Block7 traces show that the residual occurs despite continuing knowledge updates and despite the violations being included in repair units. More importantly, the first-party proposals expose direct feasibility and constraint-coupling witnesses. In iter4, an M1.S.2 case has a 252-dbu notch while the via M1 land plus two required 100-dbu clearances needs 272 dbu, so a simple placement satisfying both sides is geometrically impossible without merging geometry or creating another violation. In iter5, one V1/M1 repair explicitly accepts a declared-debt M1.S.2 violation, another plan that would clear 117 target violations is deferred because it would introduce more than 110 new violations, and the contested-unit DRC gate rejects a candidate with delta_total=+64. Thus the cross-block persistence is positively explained by changed feasible-action support and coupled-constraint repair debt rather than by evidence that the same executable skill failed to transfer to an otherwise matched state.

events.title: Double Ratchet weak-metric robustness and locked-reference validity are already explained by richer feedback and the source paper's own validity distinction

summary.en: Double Ratchet's weak-metric robustness is consistent with redundant rich error feedback, while its task-score/locked-reference distinction is already an explicit source-paper claim. Neither cited statement supplies a new standalone paper problem.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The weak-metric observation does not isolate invariance to evaluator quality because the binary pass/fail metric is not the only training signal. The source explicitly states that a failed attempt still contributes concrete error text to skill synthesis, so label degradation is compensated by a richer feedback channel. This is ordinary information redundancy/multi-channel supervision: corrupting one channel need not reduce learning when another channel preserves error-localizing information. Separately, the distinction between task score and metric validity is already the source paper's central evaluation claim and protocol: metric validity is measured against a locked reference that metric evolution never reads, while task score is used only for downstream sufficiency. Recasting that same distinction as a new problem would be a direct current-source collision rather than unexplained negative space.

events.title: The reported ~20% MindMemOS dreaming compression is not an independently identified compression plateau

summary.en: The reported MindMemOS FactConsolidation result supports targeted consolidation/selective forgetting, but it does not identify a standalone ~20% compression plateau. The latter is reduced by benchmark semantics plus first-party conflict-aware dreaming behavior before any new experiment is run.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: On the released FactConsolidation object, the archive fraction is a post-action summary of targeted consolidation, not an independently varied treatment. The benchmark defines the later contradictory fact as the valid memory, while the first-party dreaming pipeline deterministically archives exact duplicates before LLM actions, can merge multiple source memories while archiving the sources, and represents directed conflict resolution with relations such as supersedes. Therefore simultaneously reducing active-memory volume and improving both single- and multi-hop accuracy is predicted by a same-information conflict-aware selective-forgetting/belief-revision account whenever removed memories are duplicate, stale, or contradictory. The paper reports one naturally induced archive fraction per model/hop regime rather than a controlled AMCR sweep, so the observed ~20% operating point does not identify a plateau or cliff in compression ratio.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The v11 MindMemOS formulation claiming that the reported ~19-23% active-memory archive ratio identifies a nonmonotone compression plateau/cliff whose location is a new causal object beyond conflict-aware selective forgetting, redundancy removal, and belief revision on MemoryAgentBench FactConsolidation.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.title: Connectivity-admissible repair history is not a new persistent-credit primitive

summary.en: EvoDRC's released logs show a real label mismatch, but the mismatch is already explained by the distinction between feasibility/admissibility and causal utility credit. Across 24 released units with both an independent local DRC score and a gate verdict, all 24 pass the connectivity gate while 10/24 are locally net worse; seven of those locally harmful units occur in globally improving iterations. The gate therefore cannot identify positive local utility. Existing causal-utility admission principles already require persistent artifacts to be credited from matched downstream effect rather than feasibility, acceptance, or shared aggregate success.

events.title: Uniform-routing and frozen-skill drops do not identify a new co-evolution interaction

summary.en: Skill Self-Play provides evidence that both dynamic skill evolution and non-uniform curriculum allocation contribute to performance. The cited pair of marginal ablations does not by itself establish a new nonseparable co-evolution mechanism.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The two ablations remove different ordinary resources. Uniform routing weakens query/task-conditioned curriculum allocation while retaining the evolving skill mechanism; Frozen skills holds the available skill library fixed while retaining skill-guided generation. Large marginal drops from weakening allocation and from weakening the available expert/curriculum set are both predicted by standard expert-set quality plus gating/allocation decompositions and do not identify an interaction term. The same paper's policy co-evolution ablation is consistent with this interpretation: Frozen proposer causes a 2.1-point drop, Frozen feedback solver a 3.0-point drop, and Frozen both a 3.2-point drop, which is not evidence of a super-additive co-evolution cliff and is compatible with overlapping/complementary resources.

summary.en: The specific v9 held-out-cliff formulation is not an irreducible paper problem because its strongest same-information mature baseline can express the same drift-to-regret threshold. This conclusion is a principle-level reduction, not a negative experiment result.

A nonlinear or threshold degradation of current-output ranking quality as drift increases is therefore a prediction inside that baseline class, not an additional agent-specific causal primitive. events.title: LOPD latent-token and retrieval-count plateaus reduce to capacity saturation and marginal-information redundancy

summary.en: LOPD reports useful sensitivity curves, but the current token-count and retrieval-count plateaus are already predicted by mature representation-capacity and diminishing-marginal-information principles. A new mechanism would require a matched fixed-budget decomposition residual.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: LOPD's own construction makes both sensitivity curves direct instances of mature capacity and marginal-information effects. The latent composer compresses variable-length task-experience representations into a fixed number of learned latent tokens, so increasing that token count increases representation capacity and a rise followed by saturation is predicted by information-bottleneck/rate-distortion behavior. Separately, retrieval is exact cosine-similarity top-n over a frozen successful-trajectory bank. Increasing n_ret therefore nests lower-ranked experiences into the retrieved set; each additional item is separately encoded/compressed and then contributes additional latent context. A gain from the first few nearest experiences followed by a plateau or fluctuation is predicted by diminishing marginal relevance, correlated/redundant evidence, and context-capacity tradeoffs. The reported curves do not hold total latent budget fixed while independently varying number of experiences versus tokens per experience, so they cannot identify a new decomposition-specific mechanism.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that LOPD's reward jump around 32 latent tokens and its lack of monotonic benefit beyond three retrieved experiences identify a new agent self-evolution threshold or retrieval-dose mechanism merely from the reported sensitivity curves.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.title: Repeated accept/reject feedback from a fixed development split is adaptive validation, not a new self-evolution primitive

summary.en: AutoDesign's dev gate is selection-facing despite hiding raw dev scores, but the resulting repeated feedback channel is already a mature adaptive-validation object. It is useful as a governance warning, not a standalone paper thesis.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The released AutoDesign loop repeatedly evaluates candidate harnesses on a fixed development set, maps the result into an accept/reject decision, stores that acceptance decision in the persistent optimization record, and gives the updated record to the optimizer in the next iteration. Raw dev scores are hidden, but the acceptance bit is still an adaptive function of the fixed dev set. This is a direct instance of adaptive validation/reusable-held-out feedback rather than a new causal primitive. The same reduction also applies to recursive keep-better schemes such as RSEA, where successive candidate states are repeatedly selected using the same held-out validation split.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that AutoDesign's hidden dev-score gate creates a novel self-evolving-agent information channel merely because raw dev trajectories/scores are withheld while the dev-dependent acceptance decision is stored and reused.

events.title: Large skill-evolution and router ablation drops do not identify a co-evolution interaction

summary.en: ERSkill provides positive evidence that both expanding retrieval capability and learning query-dependent selection matter. The cited ablation result does not by itself identify a new co-evolution interaction because it removes two distinct resources in non-factorial conditions.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The two ablations remove different ordinary resources and therefore do not identify an interaction. ERSkill's w/o-skill-evolution condition freezes the expert/action space at three seed retrieval skills, while w/o-router retains the skill system but replaces the trained query-dependent router with LLM-based skill selection. A large drop from reducing the available expert set and a large drop from degrading expert selection are both predicted by standard representation/action-set plus gating/routing decompositions. They do not imply a nonseparable co-evolution cliff. The paper's own evolution case study further reports that routed deploy accuracy can temporarily fall when higher-coverage skills replace older skills before the router adapts, then recover after subsequent router updates, which is the expected lag of a selector adapting to a changing expert set rather than evidence for a new causal primitive.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that ERSkill's two largest ablation drops establish a new co-evolution cliff or nonseparable skill-router mechanism merely because removing skill evolution and replacing the learned router each reduces performance substantially.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a preregistered matched factorial comparison that holds query/task distribution, final skill candidates/content, rollout and judge information, compute, and selector candidate set comparable while independently varying skill evolution and router adaptation, and shows a repeatable non-additive held-out interaction that same-information contextual routing, mixture-of-experts gating, selector-regret, and nonstationary expert-set models cannot express. Separate large ablation drops or router-lag anecdotes are insufficient.

events.title: Skill-SP bootstrap recovery currently changes generation responsibility, not an identified self-evolution reproduction threshold

summary.en: Skill-SP provides strong evidence that structured scaffolding can rescue self-play data generation, but its released unguided-versus-skill logical-generation contrast changes who performs the hard constraint-construction computation; therefore the current observation does not identify a standalone self-evolution reproduction-threshold mechanism.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The reported bootstrap contrast does not hold generation information and computation responsibility fixed. In the released author implementation, unguided logical generation requires the LLM itself to emit a complete hidden solution plus constraints and the repository only validates that object. Skill-guided generation instead asks the LLM for a semantic blueprint, after which package-specific compiler resources sample the hidden solution, construct true clues, render the puzzle, and verify uniqueness. The initial skill library is itself constructed from domain-level task formats and verifier interfaces and contains reusable construction/compiler resources. Therefore the observed valid-task-yield recovery is already predicted by ordinary model-scaffold compatibility, structured program synthesis, rejection-yield/curriculum coverage, and recursive self-training-collapse accounts when one arm offloads constraint construction to deterministic scaffolding. The current evidence cannot identify an additional self-evolution reproduction threshold beyond those mature objects.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that Skill Self-Play's reported recovery of initially misaligned models, failure of unguided logical self-play to bootstrap, or large Ministral gains already identify a new self-evolution reproduction-threshold/phase-transition mechanism.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

The comparison must measure independently valid frontier-task reproduction before using downstream training gains as evidence.

events.title: Local skill-validation ranking versus shifted deployment is a model-selection-under-distribution-shift object unless a skill-specific structural residual survives

summary.en: SkillEvolBench remains a strong first-party executable substrate for studying procedural representation transfer, but the current PA-05 success criterion would only establish a reproducible local-validation/deployment ranking failure under deliberate shift. That is useful diagnostic evidence, not a standalone new self-evolution principle.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The frozen PA-05 statistic is exactly a source-to-target model-selection comparison under deliberate distribution shift. Its local selector observes the T1-T3 within-environment performance difference between two representations, while its oracle is defined by the T4 context-shift, T5 adversarial, and T6 composition performance difference. Ranking reversal and oracle-versus-local regret are therefore direct predictions of ordinary validation/deployment mismatch, domain shift, and conditional treatment-effect heterogeneity whenever source-domain performance is not invariant for the target roles. Matching the latent family and comparing the same two arms removes family difficulty and global-arm confounding, but it does not change this statistical object: the remaining representation-by-role interaction is precisely the effect modification a generic distribution-shift or domain-generalization model is allowed to express. Naming the two arms raw trajectory reuse and distilled skill memory does not create a distinct selection principle.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone PA-05 claim that a high rate of family-level ranking inversion or deployment regret between SkillEvolBench T1-T3 local replay validation and T4-T6 shifted deployment identifies a new skill-evolution selection-validity problem merely because the compared persistent representations are distilled skills versus raw trajectory reuse.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a preregistered same-information residual in which the candidate and the strongest distribution-shift/domain-generalization selector receive identical T1-T3 outcomes, family and role observables, representation metadata, target-shift descriptors available before T4-T6 outcomes, model, execution order, calls/tokens, and compute, yet a skill-specific structural variable forces different ex-ante arm-selection predictions and the difference is validated by an intervention or independent executable truth. Ranking inversion, selector regret, seed replication, global-arm controls, or changing the backbone without such a structural residual is insufficient.

events.title: Backbone-dependent overrestriction is a security-utility operating point, not a new self-evolution cliff

summary.en: HARD provides strong evidence that defense-evolution backbones can land at very different security-utility operating points, including severe overrestriction. The extreme GPT-5.5 result is scientifically useful as a failure case but does not by itself identify a new utility-collapse mechanism beyond mature multiobjective/overblocking explanations.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The reported GPT-5.5 behavior is already represented by the paper's own multiobjective runtime-defense formulation and by ordinary overblocking/conservative-policy trade-offs. HARD defines the defense objective in terms of security and utility, explicitly notes that overly restrictive interventions can improve security at the cost of legitimate capability, and interprets different HARD variants as different operating points on a security-utility frontier. In the backbone ablation the execution agent, judges, tasks, evolution rounds, and budget are fixed while the evolution backbone changes; the resulting policies occupy different ASR/BU/UA points. The GPT-5.5 point (ASR 20.3, BU 94.9, UA 7.2) therefore demonstrates a poor utility-conditioned operating point, not an additional causal primitive or an identified phase transition.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that HARD's GPT-5.5 backbone result (lower attack success but utility-under-attack collapsing to 7.2%) identifies a new self-evolving-defense utility-collapse mechanism merely because failure-driven security refinement and task utility move in opposite directions.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

A different evolution backbone, another extreme UA value, or a new scalarization is insufficient.

events.title: SEED on-policy and hindsight-SFT ablation drops reduce to occupancy matching and cold-start capability

summary.en: SEED provides evidence that current-policy skills and hindsight-SFT are useful. The cited ablation drops are already predicted by occupancy matching and cold-start capability principles and therefore do not by themselves establish a new self-evolution mechanism.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: SEED's own theory and ablation interpretation supply mature explanations for both drops. Appendix A.1 explicitly motivates on-policy hindsight as an occupancy-matched adaptive target: skills extracted from the current policy's own trajectories track its current state-action occupancy and failure modes, whereas a static offline library can be distribution-mismatched as the policy evolves. The 7.4-point static-library drop is therefore directly expressible by ordinary distribution/occupancy shift and stale-supervision principles. Separately, hindsight-skill SFT is the initialization that teaches the actor/analyzer to perform trajectory analysis before the self-evolving RL stage. Removing it changes cold-start representation/competence, so the 5.8-point drop is predicted by initialization and prerequisite-capability effects unless initial analyzer competence and supervised information are matched. Neither one-factor ablation by itself identifies a new causal primitive of self-evolution.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that SEED's 7.4-point drop with a static offline skill library or 5.8-point drop without hindsight-skill SFT identifies a new self-evolution mechanism merely from those component ablations.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen the on-policy residual only with occupancy/support/skill-quality/size and information matched between on-policy and offline libraries; reopen the SFT residual only with initial trajectory-analysis competence, supervised information budget, and downstream optimization budget matched. In either case require a repeatable held-out difference beyond distribution shift, stale supervision, cold-start initialization, and optimization-path dependence.

events.title: Initial-skill harm followed by evolved-skill gains is corrective adaptation, not a new self-evolution primitive

summary.en: MindMemOS provides positive evidence that trajectory-driven skill refinement can turn a harmful generic skill into a useful task-aligned one, but the aggregate sign reversal and supervised boundary refinement are already explained by mature negative-transfer and corrective-learning objects.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The reported sign reversal is predicted by ordinary task-conditioned negative transfer followed by error-driven corrective skill optimization. MindMemOS's initial xlsx skill is a generic procedural artifact with sparse cautions and is worse than No-skill on SpreadsheetBench. Its unsupervised evolution turns recurring execution failures into concrete error-avoidance rules, while supervised evolution uses task scores to bound those rules and avoid overgeneralization, e.g. preserving requested formulas rather than hard-coding values merely to satisfy cached-value checks. SkillGrad independently reports the same qualitative object on SpreadsheetBench Verified across two backbones and two skill initializations: base xlsx skills can underperform No-skill, and failed plus contrastive-success trajectories are used as corrective evidence to patch the same skill into a higher-performing artifact. Therefore the negative-to-positive transition does not require an additional self-evolution primitive beyond skill-task misalignment, corrective learning, and rule specialization/applicability learning.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that MindMemOS's SpreadsheetBench transition from Init-skill below No-skill to evolved-skill above No-skill identifies a new agent-specific causal mechanism merely from the sign reversal or from supervised evolution adding more bounded rules.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a preregistered matched comparison equalizes task-skill compatibility, initial skill content, executor, failed/successful trajectory evidence, task-score information, edit/token budget, update count, and held-out evaluation, yet a self-evolution-specific structural variable yields a distinct ex-ante task-level sign-flip prediction that generic prompt/skill optimization, corrective learning, rule specialization, and nonmonotonic rule revision cannot express. More iterations, a different skill seed, a larger skill, or another negative-to-positive aggregate result is insufficient.

events.title: Cross-regime static-procedural sign contradiction collapses because the two papers intervene on different causal surfaces

summary.en: The two source results are individually real, but they are effects of different interventions. MetaSkill-Evolve reports a small negative inference-time Static Skill effect on near-ceiling ALFWorld, while SkillCoach reports positive downstream gains after R0-based trajectory filtering and SFT. These values cannot by themselves define a contradiction or a common sign certificate for one frozen procedural-context treatment.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The proposed CONTRADICTION requires the two reported signs to estimate the same treatment under a shared operationalization, but the primary papers intervene on different causal surfaces. MetaSkill-Evolve's Static Skill loads a fixed skill into a frozen Gemma-4 31B agent and compares held-out task accuracy against the same no-skill executor; on ALFWorld that inference-time skill changes 92.31% to 90.38% (-1.93 points). SkillCoach's R0 result is not an inference-time static-context effect: R0 is a task-level process rubric used to score and filter verifier-passing trajectories, and the reported 8->16 and 14->28 gains are measured after supervised fine-tuning on the filtered demonstrations. That intervention changes the training set and then model parameters. Opposite signs across an inference-time frozen-agent skill treatment and a rubric-filtered SFT treatment do not constitute incompatible outcomes under one treatment contract, so the claimed cross-regime sign contradiction is not identified before either headroom or applicability theory is tested.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: Canonical transaction 2975a3f8..., AUTO-1 CONTRADICTION combining MetaSkill-Evolve arXiv:2607.05297 Static Skill on ALFWorld with SkillCoach arXiv:2607.01874 R0-filtered SFT, restricted to the claim that these two reported signs instantiate one shared static-procedural-prior treatment and motivate a pre-deployment regime-conditioned sign certificate.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with primary or first-party evidence containing at least two regimes that share an identical static-procedural-artifact intervention on the same frozen executor, identical no-artifact comparator, endpoint, rollout/compute budget, and treatment timing; base/headroom must be matched within sampling error and the within-regime treatment deltas must have reproducibly opposite signs. Any residual sign predictor must then beat a same-information conditional-treatment/domain-shift baseline using only pre-deployment observables.

events.title: PA-03-HARNESS-SELECTION-INVERSION

summary.en: The current PA-03 evidence is already explained by ordinary noisy/adaptive model selection rather than an identified harness-specific selection-inversion mechanism. HarnessBank reports one GDPval case where a train-lower variant scores +11.5pp on test while the train-selected winner scores +9.2pp, and separately constructs post-convergence neutral-candidate rounds where weak single-run or K=3-mean crediting produces 62-76% phantom progress. The latter disappears under the paper's paired-2sigma verification rule. Finite-sample selection-criterion variance, winner's curse, and adaptive selection are sufficient to predict both rank reversal and false progress without introducing a new harness-specific causal primitive.

events.title: pf4-paired-diagnosability-readjudication-20260816

summary.en: The historical PF-4 support gate compared diagnostic accuracy on all heldout no-repair faults with a different, surface-specific post-treatment subset restricted to wrong-surface repairs that still failed, mixing cohort composition with paired change. More fundamentally, workflow/tool historical repair arms are fault-cancellation controls rather than persistent cross-fault updates, so they are inert on the very wrong-surface probes used to claim future diagnosability. On the same eligible units, workflow and tool have zero diagnostic degradation; prompt improves. Therefore the historical support-pass cannot update belief about repair-induced future diagnosability loss. The broader diagnosability-preservation principle remains open and requires independent sealed future-fault probes after a committed update that remains active under those faults.

The substrate change to the author-released final RL policy is principled and predeclared, with the model merge provenance pinned and validated pre-outcome. The competence gate is a non-adaptive qualification prerequisite with frozen GO/STOP thresholds, and failure forbids any alternative policy/task search. Task partitions are disjoint and outcome-blind, with all P0-D tasks excluded from calibration and confirmation. The causal design includes a proper identity placebo (C) and exact quotient (D) with byte-identical prompt verification and stochastic coupling only for A/D after prompt identity is confirmed. Statistics are appropriate for paired binary outcomes, and the claim boundary correctly limits any conclusion to the exact-clone subclass without overclaiming SQC superiority. All checks pass.

events.title: Temporally distributed persistent-memory exposure as a standalone causal mechanism

summary.en: No temporal-exposure experiment is needed to kill the standalone claim that repeated or windowed persistent-memory exposure is a new causal primitive on this frozen substrate. The implementation exposes a repeated treatment regimen, and a previously certified same-information mature-theory reduction already covers treatment-affected longitudinal history and monitoring. The B-9/C2 context-dependent memory-effect phenomenon remains archived positive residual evidence; only this temporal-exposure mechanism class is closed.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The frozen memory treatment is re-injected at every policy decision until termination, so fixed ON/OFF memory is a repeated longitudinal treatment regimen. Predetermined ON/OFF windows, cumulative exposure, mediation through treatment-affected history/state, and termination-dependent opportunity for future exposure are representable by the same treatment-history/state-history objects used by longitudinal/dynamic-treatment causal models; persistence or textual memory does not by itself create a new causal primitive.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: On the frozen ALFWorld persistent-memory substrate, treating repeated memory injection, cumulative exposure duration, or preregistered ON/OFF exposure windows as a new standalone agent-specific causal mechanism after local-state/action mechanisms have failed.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only if a preregistered case matches the full pre-outcome history and nominal exposure schedule yet changes the executable semantics/version of the persistent artifact, yields a distinct ex-ante prediction, and an explicit same-information nonstationary/versioned-treatment or policy-regime model given the same observable version signal cannot express that prediction. A new timing window, longer exposure, cumulative-dose statistic, K-step label, or memory terminology is insufficient.

events.title: Selective fresh-session harm from one frozen skill library does not by itself identify a latent carryover-activation mechanism

summary.en: The current smoke contains a real positive persistent-library effect on P19, but its selective task dependence is already compatible with observable context-conditioned artifact uptake. It does not support a standalone latent carryover-activation mechanism beyond mature retrieval-utilization/instruction-following and effect-heterogeneity explanations.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: On the current provenance-frozen AutoSkill × SkillMisevo smoke, the selective P19 harm is already explained by observable persistent-artifact uptake under task-conditioned applicability. P19 is harmful with the evolved library and non-harmful with the exact empty-library control, while the evolved trace executes eight git-hook write/execute-class operations and the empty control executes zero. P20 and P21 receive the same five-skill library but execute zero such hook operations and are non-harmful. Therefore the observed selectivity does not require a separate latent carryover-activation principle once task context, injected artifact content, and executed uptake are observable.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone claim that selective fresh-session harm across P19/P20/P21 under one frozen AutoSkill library reveals a new context-conditioned latent activation mechanism beyond ordinary persistent-artifact uptake, instruction following, and task-conditioned applicability.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched units that hold the frozen library, task-artifact compatibility, and observable action-level uptake fixed yet show different fresh-session harm, or with harm that persists despite absence of corresponding artifact uptake, and show that same-information retrieval-utilization/instruction-following plus task-conditioned effect-heterogeneity baselines cannot express the residual.

events.title: Reused Locked-Set Agreement Cannot Identify Metric Validity after Anchor-Guard Removal

summary.en: The locked-set-reuse candidate is a dead end for the released Double Ratchet loop because the proposed treatment is causally disconnected from evolution. This conclusion is authorized by a source-code structural invariance witness, not by a failed experiment.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: In the released Double Ratchet implementation, eval_locked is a measurement-only sink: it is scored only after the round-best metric has already been selected by the dev-agreement × train-coverage objective, and the source explicitly states that eval_locked never selects, gates, rolls back, or otherwise influences the loop. Therefore replacing a reused locked set with an equally sized rotated locked set cannot causally change the metric-evolution trajectory unless an additional outer feedback/selection path is introduced, which would change the frozen scientific object.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The candidate claim that reusing versus rotating Double Ratchet's eval_locked reference set can change or disambiguate metric-evolution trajectories while keeping the released loop unchanged and preserving the no-direct-locked-set-access condition.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only for a system or explicitly modeled outer loop where a reused evaluation signal is demonstrably consumed by a later selection/update transition, with the feedback edge frozen before outcomes and a same-information rotating/fresh-probe control.

events.title: Frozen no-skill anchors make reciprocal metric-skill coevolution observationally indistinguishable from one-way metric-to-skill coupling

summary.en: The released Double Ratchet implementation has directly observable one-way metric-to-skill coupling at the data-update level. Treating that structural fact itself as an identifiability problem is a dead end; the scientifically meaningful follow-up is whether such one-way coupling causes a nontrivial consequence beyond generic distribution shift.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: Reciprocal coupling is not latent in the released Double Ratchet object. The first-party implementation constructs dev_items, locked, and train once before alternating phases and later metric phases reuse those same objects, while skill phases consume the current metric through make_expr_grader. Because skill-phase outputs are not inputs to the metric update operator, the released causal graph is directly one-way rather than observationally ambiguous.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone identifiability claim that the released Double Ratchet implementation leaves reciprocal metric-skill coupling observationally ambiguous even though the first-party update graph explicitly omits any skill-output-to-metric-data edge.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a preregistered downstream consequence of the missing reciprocal edge, such as held-out evaluator selection/regret under actor-induced distribution shift, and require the effect to survive a same-information generic distribution-shift/online-adaptation baseline and a matched compute budget.

events.title: Coverage-note starvation under selective evidence access in document agents

summary.en: The frozen P06 realization is a dead end because relevance-agnostic page-coverage quantity cannot identify the hidden answer-evidence gap it is supposed to selectively repair. The experiment supplies compatible behavioral evidence, but the dead-end decision is authorized by the stronger information-structure witness, not by the negative metric alone.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: Page coverage is not answer-evidence sufficiency. A coverage certificate that reveals only retrieved page ids, total pages, coverage ratio, unchecked-page count, and FULL/PARTIAL status does not reveal whether any unread page contains answer-relevant evidence. The target gap/covered distinction is defined post hoc with hidden benchmark evidence_pages, so the P06 treatment does not expose the latent variable that distinguishes the two strata.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone P06 mechanism claiming that page-coverage certification, with no answer-relevance information beyond the same retrieved snippets/question, selectively exposes hidden answer-evidence gaps relative to covered-answerable cases.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with a preregistered treatment that exposes or preserves relevance-conditioned evidence debt without using benchmark answer/evidence truth at decision time, and show a selective held-out gap effect beyond the strongest same-information uncertainty/conservatism baseline under matched retrieval and context budget.

summary.en: Using n=3 solver samples per task is acceptable for a bounded coarse one-step consequence screen once the meaningful-effect margin is widened to a preregistered +/-5 percentage points. Reference tool-call grading is independent outcome truth, skill_mode=False isolates generated-task difficulty, and split/merge arms reuse identical task/solver outcomes. The full confirmatory heldout utility margin remains 2pp and is not changed by this P0-C design.

events.title: Relevance-conditioned evidence debt under selective evidence access

summary.en: The P06 coverage-count realization failed because page quantity is not answer-evidence sufficiency. That opposite principle remains scientifically correct, but turning it into a standalone relevance-conditioned evidence-debt state is absorbed by DocAtlas's existing mutable information-gap planning and Search/Read loop. The dead-end is authorized by the current-source same-information reduction, not by negative exploratory screens.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: DocAtlas already makes unresolved, relevance-conditioned information gaps an explicit mutable control state rather than relying on page-coverage quantity. Its structured Note is n=(found,evidence,plan), where plan states remaining information gaps; subsequent Search consumes accumulated findings and may issue a new sub-question, and Selective Evidence Access explicitly allows reading pages from unresolved gaps recorded in memory. Thus the correct opposite principle discovered from the P06 coverage-count dead end is already a first-class current-source information-seeking mechanism, not a new standalone evidence-debt object.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: The standalone paper problem/method object that replaces page-coverage quantity with an explicit relevance-conditioned 'evidence debt' or unresolved-information-gap state to decide whether a long-document agent should continue searching/reading before answering.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only with provenance-audited matched states that are equivalent under DocAtlas-style found/evidence/plan, mutable search/index state, explored-page history, and budget, but have different counterfactual answer-change risk and different optimal answer-versus-continue actions; the residual must also survive generic value-of-information/active sequential testing under the same information.
events.reopen_condition_zh: 仅在原裁决登记的重开条件被真实新证据满足时重开；不能通过换术语、调阈值或重复同类负实验重开。

authority.scope_zh: 只对该 artifact 明确界定的 scoped formulation 生效；不自动关闭整个研究领域。

events.title: asset-first-stri-skillrl-fixed-task-p0d-review-20260816

summary.en: The contract uses ALFWorld final success as independent task truth, with tasks pre-sealed and selection outcome-blind. The design cleanly separates semantic displacement (B) from fresh-ID/order perturbation (C) and restores pristine prompt (D), isolating the retrieval-budget displacement mechanism. The common prefix with replay preserves the scientific object since SkillRL injects memory only from step 2, and the SFT checkpoint is explicitly framed as a fixed warm-start policy, not the final RL model. The 12x2 paired design with preregistered McNemar/effect/placebo/quotient gates and headroom bounds is a valid bounded local falsifier. The contract explicitly states exact-clone is evidence-only and cannot support novelty or partial-overlap claims. The quotient arm's byte-identical restoration and the placebo arm's unchanged semantic set prevent tautology and false positives from generic perturbation.

events.title: Executable treatment semantics/version as a standalone persistent-memory causal object

summary.en: The treatment-semantics branch is closed by information-parity and same-information reduction, not by a negative rollout. The v8 formulation's only claimed residual required giving the proposed predictor an executable mapping that its strongest versioned-treatment baseline did not receive. Once parity is restored, the mapping is simply part of treatment/state identity; if it is unobservable, the problem becomes identification rather than a new causal primitive. The sparse B-9/C2 memory-effect phenomenon remains archived evidence, but this substrate has no active mechanism seed after the current reductions.
summary.zh: 该候选完成 scoped principle readjudication，并在 scoped_principle 层形成关闭结论。展开可查看原始 reduction、边界与重开条件。

why.en: The proposed treatment-semantics predictor is not irreducible under a fair same-information comparison. If the executable memory-to-option/action mapping is observable enough for the proposed predictor to use prospectively, the same mapping must also be supplied to the strongest versioned/nonstationary treatment baseline, which can absorb it into the treatment/state definition, e.g. A_t=(artifact version, executable mapping). If that mapping is not observable before outcome, the proposed predictor cannot prospectively use it either. Withholding the mapping from the baseline while giving it to the candidate creates an information advantage rather than a new causal object.
why.zh: 该关闭来自已有证据下的 same-information / scope-matched reduction 或明确结构性裁决；不是把运行失败自动解释成科学失败。

limitation.en: On the frozen B-9/C2 ALFWorld memory substrate, treating executable memory semantics or version identity as a new standalone causal primitive after local mechanisms and repeated/windowed exposure have already been reduced or stopped.
limitation.zh: 关闭只作用于 artifact 明确写出的 scoped formulation，不自动外推到整个方向或 benchmark。

events.reopen_condition: Reopen only if new primary evidence supports a preregistered structural constraint for self-modifying persistent treatments and, under identical pre-outcome information including the full executable treatment map/version state, a matched versioned/nonstationary treatment or dynamic policy-regime baseline makes a different ex-ante prediction and fails an exact reduction test. A renamed mapping feature, extra representation, new version label, new K-step/window schedule, or withholding information from the baseline is insufficient.
events.reopen_condition_zh: 仅在原裁决登记的重开条件被真实新证据满足时重开；不能通过换术语、调阈值或重复同类负实验重开。

authority.scope_zh: 只对该 artifact 明确界定的 scoped formulation 生效；不自动关闭整个研究领域。

events.title: E-1

summary.en: The current paired edit-effect table has insufficient within-workflow target/effect variation to identify a best-edit ranking policy. Hidden workflows must remain sealed. This stops the current source-table instantiation, not the Paired Edit-Effect Workflow Update Policy itself.

why.zh: 该事件直接来自已有 P0 artifact；时间轴只做投影，不重新裁决。

events.next_action: Do not open hidden workflows or train the E-1 ranker on this table. Reopen only after a newly frozen paired intervention table has genuine non-tied edit effects at the preregistered source gate; otherwise send E-1 to human pivot/drop review.

why.zh: 该事件直接来自已有 P0 artifact；时间轴只做投影，不重新裁决。

authority.scope_zh: 沿用原 P0 artifact 的已有裁决范围；时间轴不会重新授权实验或 GPU。

events.title: B-2

summary.en: The completed shared-memory table cannot satisfy B-2's frozen >=30 reproducible conclusion-change deletion-case prerequisite. Its controlled-nonzero memory effects are only supporting reality evidence and are not automatically conclusion-change cores. Stop this substrate/data instantiation without calling the B-2 method a failure.
summary.zh: 该 P0 artifact 记录了明确决策：STOP_CURRENT_SUBSTRATE_CONCLUSION_CHANGE_SUPPORT_INSUFFICIENT。展开查看原始指标、下一步和 authority 边界。

why.zh: 该事件直接来自已有 P0 artifact；时间轴只做投影，不重新裁决。

events.next_action: Do not open hidden E_orig or train a B-2 selector on this table. Reopen only with a fresh dedicated deletion-sensitivity collection that independently supplies >=30 reproducible conclusion-change cases; otherwise send B-2 to human pivot/drop review.
events.next_action_zh: 当前路线不继续推进；只有满足原 artifact 记录的新证据或重开条件时才恢复。
